description: Cross-language golden vectors for the derived server identifier. Every client host derives routing identity from the gateway URL alone, so a language that canonicalises differently gives one server two identities and splits a fleet in half. These vectors are the shared statement of the derivation; the Go, TypeScript and C# loaders each assert against them.
algorithm: canonical = scheme://host[:port] + path with trailing slashes removed, credentials, query and fragment absent; serverId = "srv_" + lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical URL as UTF-8
note: Inputs are restricted to URLs on which the three loaders already agree. Default-port normalisation and host case folding are recorded as divergences in the expected-outcome corpus rather than here, because Go preserves both today while TypeScript and C# fold them.
